text:
liam-mkt: Quick pitch 1: SparkKit  a tiny weekly launch series: 3 short tutorials (24 min reads) + 1 mini refapp (single-file) per month. goal: lower barrier for trying Redwood. Thoughts? :sparkles:
devrel-jo: big yes. keep friction < 5min to get request <-> response. each tutorial should include an immediate "Try it in Docker" snippet and a mini benchmark snapshot.
emma: for distribution, push to blog, tweet thread, and add 1-2 gifs showing latency. also include a short video (<60s) walkthrough for the refapp.
ryan-eng: technical ask: refapp should be a minimal express/python/flask app with 3 endpoints: /health, /generate, /embed. single Dockerfile, env var for REDWOOD_API_KEY. example snippet:
```bash
# run locally
docker build -t sparkkit-ref .
docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx -p 8080:8080 sparkkit-ref
```
qa-bot: checklist updated: link check, sample env var guidance, small security note about not committing keys.
alex-p: ops: I'll create repo template + GitHub Actions for CI (lint, build image). can also add a small action to publish a benchmark CSV artifact.
liam-mkt: timeline proposal:
- Week 0: scaffold repo + baseline benchmark (ryan, alex)
- Week 1: Snack #1: "LLM search ranking in 5" + refapp starter post (jo, emma)
- Week 2: Snack #2 + benchmark update
- Week 3: Snack #3 + office hours (30m) + collect community PRs
- Month end: stitch mini-refapp v1 and PR credits

devrel-jo: messaging hooks: "Build a ranked search in 10 minutes" / "Try Redwood dedupe & rerank in under 5". also include an "Advanced" note linking to Dedicated and Private configs.
emma: inbound routing: add a form in blog post capturing use-case, company size, and whether they want a demo. submissions go to a public sheet + zap to sales if enterprise checkbox checked.
ryan-eng: benchmark plan: compare 3 configs: hosted small, dedicated baseline, quantized-private. metrics: p50 latency, p95, cost per 1k tokens, CPU/GPU mem. sample output as small table in blog.
liam-mkt: ok assign: jo (content), alex (repo + CI), ryan (bench scripts), emma (distribution + creative), jo & ryan (office hours). will run a 6-week pilot.
devrel-jo: I'll draft Snack #1 today and ping for review. :rocket:
